user_problem: An intake process needs clear field requirements that vary by request type and downstream need.
unique_output: A specification of fields, conditional requiredness, accepted format, purpose, validation source, and incomplete-case handling.
required_input: Request types, field list, routing needs, format rules, optionality rules, and rejection policy.
critical_rule: Do not make a field mandatory merely because it seems useful; requiredness must trace to supplied rules.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is configuration-key-drift-check; this specifies conditional business intake fields rather than comparing configuration key names.
acceptance_scenario: Input says email required for Support, purchase order required only for Procurement, description required for both. Output creates conditional rules and marks a Support request lacking email incomplete but not missing a purchase order.
